method: Built-in image_gen, one transparent edit per original wall sprite

edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent 2D isometric survival-game wall sprite, edit target Image 1, wall segment 1. Add tasteful living green moss and a few small climbing ivy patches directly to THIS EXACT existing battered timber wall. Forest-green and soft olive moss cushions grow irregularly along the bottom of upright logs and shaded crossrails; 2 or 3 small leafy vines climb across a few posts and rails, providing clearly visible green contrast against warm orange terrain. Leave at least 70 percent of the wood visible, preserve the golden cut spike tips and dark bark shadows. Same detailed hand-painted game style, tiny defined leaves, crisp linework. Critical invariants: keep every existing log, broken spike, buttress, rope, structural gap and piece of wood EXACTLY in its original position, with the same outline, curvature, angle, perspective, proportions, scale, lighting, canvas alignment and original transparent empty margins. This is a surface-treatment edit, NOT a redesign or new wall. Do not straighten the curve, move or center the asset, add wall sections, repair broken wood, add gates, add ground or stones or big bushes. Do not add a backdrop: retain genuinely transparent background and clean alpha edges, no red fringe. Moss should grow ON the wood; no foliage elsewhere on the empty canvas. Output only this one edited wall sprite.
